 Which passports may be problematic for travel 
 When flying within the United States , authorities require as a mandatory condition that acceptable identification be presented at all checkpoints, a measure that aligns with the federal Real ID Act that took effect last year.
 The regulation establishes that the only driver’s licenses accepted for boarding the aircraft are those with the official Real ID seal. However, there are other identifications that can be shown and that will be accepted in California, Florida, Texas, New York or any other state in the country , one of them is the American passport in all its formats.
 Documents . USCIS raises immigration fees in October: Which applicants will pay more? abre en nueva pestaña All states allow flying within the United States by showing a passport
 According to what was stated by the State Department and by the Transportation Security Administration , both the passport book and the passport card are valid alternatives accepted in place of Real ID for flying within the country.
 It is important to consider that TSA will consider them valid even with up to two years past expiration , just like any of the official documents on the list released by the authorities, which also includes:
 Enhanced driver’s license (EDL) or Enhanced Identification Card (EID) 
 Mobile driver’s licenses (mDL) -the approved ones for domestic use- 
 DHS trusted traveler cards 
 U.S. Department of Defense identification 
 Permanent resident card 
 Border crossing card 
 Acceptable photo ID issued by a federally recognized tribal nation or Native American community 
 HSPD-12 PIV card 
 Foreign passport 
 Canadian provincial driver’s license or Indian and Northern Affairs Canada card 
 Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC) 
 U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services Employment Authorization Card (l-766) 
 U.S. Merchant Mariner Credential 
 Veteran Health Identification Card (VHIC) 
 The following are also accepted:
 Apple Digital ID 
 Clear ID 
 Google ID pass 
 Which passports may be problematic for travel
 According to what authorities explained, when a traveler’s passport is severely damaged , it may be rejected for any trip.
 This is only if the document has considerable tears or stains, not if it shows normal wear and tear, such as fanned pages.
 When a passport is severely damaged, it is not eligible for the renewal process, but must be processed from scratch by submitting Form DS-11.
